review.summary: Marco Bezzecchi won the Grand Prix of Indonesia for Aprilia Racing, with Jorge Martin third also on the podium, while Raul Fernandez of SuperFile Trackhouse finished second. The top four were alternating Aprilia and SuperFile Trackhouse riders, ahead of Pedro Acosta's Red Bull KTM in fifth. Marc Marquez was sixth.

Raul Fernandez of SuperFile Trackhouse finished second and Jorge Martin third for Aprilia Racing.
Toprak Razgatlioglu, Jack Miller, Francesco Bagnaia and Fermin Aldeguer all did not finish.

review.summary: Taylor Barnard drove through the field from sixth to claim victory for DS Penske, ahead of Mahindra Racing's Nyck De Vries who took second from pole and teammate Edoardo Mortara third from second. The classification showed strong recoveries, including Buemi climbing to fifth and Rowland up to ninth, while front-row starts faded: Pascal Wehrlein dropped from third to fourteenth and Nico Müller from fourth to twelfth.
highlights: Oliver Rowland made the biggest recovery, climbing eight positions from seventeenth to ninth for Nissan.
Taylor Barnard drove from sixth to take his victory for DS Penske and 25 points.
Nyck De Vries took second from pole position, with Mahindra teammate Edoardo Mortara third.
Joel Eriksson and Lucas Di Grassi started fifteenth and twentieth but did not finish the race.
